entities.summary: Pierre-Luc Dubois is a Canadian professional ice hockey player who is a centre for the Washington Capitals of the National Hockey League (NHL). Dubois was born in Sainte-Agathe-des-Monts, Quebec, but grew up in Rimouski. He was drafted third overall in the 2016 NHL entry draft by the Columbus Blue Jackets, and has also played for the Winnipeg Jets and Los Angeles Kings.
